```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Reset the environment
rm(list=ls())
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Pacman is a package that helps you more parsimoniously download and attach other packages
if("pacman" %in% installed.packages() == FALSE) {install.packages("pacman")}
pacman::p_load(ggplot2,
               dplyr,
               tidyverse,
               magrittr,
               foreign,
               ggcorrplot,
               Hmisc,
               psych,
               ggdist,
               rstatix,
               effectsize)

# Set this directory to wherever your own data are saved
setwd("C:/Users/wilso/OneDrive/Desktop/Lab Projects/Disease concealment/Duration Study/intermediate/")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in data
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# When the data are in CSV format (as they are when you download from Qualtrics) this is a simple function to use
load("./study 3 cleaned and recoded.rda")

# Filter out participants who meet the pre-registered exclusion criteria
cleaned %<>% filter(problem == 0)
```

## Primary Analyses

```{r primary}
# descriptives split by condition
describeBy(select(cleaned, concealment_dv, condition), group = cleaned$condition)

# T test
t.test(concealment_dv ~ condition, data = cleaned)
cohens_d(concealment_dv ~ condition, data = cleaned)

# duration check
t.test(duration_check_1 ~ condition, data = cleaned)
```
